**Region & data**
- 60×60 grid cells (lat 54.46–55.64 °N, lon 16.06–17.24 °E) within the specified bounds; daily SST in kelvin from `cmems_obs-sst_bal_phy-temp_my_l4_P1D-m` (complete time axis 1982–2023).
